goal: Allow transactions testing soft forks or non-mandatory script rules into testnet mempools
Ensures -acceptnonstdtxn=1 skips policy script verification on test networks
agreement: Broad support for simplifying soft-fork testing on test networks (benthecarman, ismaelsadeeq)
Approach approved after resolving compile-time flag check design (sedited, fjahr)
Unaddressed objection: alters -acceptnonstdtxn beyond expected Knots behavior (luke-jr)
Minor suggestions remain open for log messages and a release note (instagibbs, fjahr)

categories.name: mempool
why: P3 because policy relaxation is confined to test networks with -acceptnonstdtxn=1
Benefits developers testing upcoming soft forks but offers no mainnet impact
